course_review/1.card_source: OpenGolfAPI 608f30b6-7f7f-4e74-9f67-4cbbc7916e1e (golfify, club site: no card). Black 7,092 / Green 6,636, par 72. Not cross-checked: the rv10 web fetch of the club site, GolfPass, AllSquare and BlueGolf had not come back by the deadline.

holes.notes: OSM golf=hole way 1 (par 4) with an OSM green; the Black tee is on an OSM box at 412 = card. The Green tee is on a lidar pad 8 yds off an OSM box (minor). The picture shows a tree-lined fairway with the line down its middle.

Hole 2's green is the SAME point as hole 9's green (-95.28911, 38.95213). The Black tee is a 76-yd walk-back from the nearest OSM box, about 110 m from the hole 9 tee. Two holes cannot share one green: hole 2 is mis-routed (the structure placement scored itself 30% sure). The real hole 2 (par 5, 534) tee and green are unknown without a course map.

The tee shot runs across the clubhouse and its parking lot (phone screenshot), and the tee is a 112-yd walk-back from any OSM box. The line is not a golf hole. The structure placement scored itself 37% sure.
Par 3, 208. The OSM green with bunkers is plausible. The Black tee is a 25-yd walk-back (Green set 6 yds), so the number of the hole is unconfirmed.
Lidar-pad tee 17 yds off an OSM box. Measured 385 vs card 396. The calm pick lands 90 yds (Black) / 99 yds (Green) from any fairway, which points to the wrong tee or wrong green for this number.
The Black tee is a 108-yd walk-back from the nearest OSM box (Green 69 yds), so the tee is not trusted. The green is an OSM green.
Par 3, 236. The Black tee is a lidar pad 42 yds off an OSM box. The green outline is plausible. The Green set passes.
Par 5, 512. The Black tee is a 58-yd walk-back. Green set: the 4-wood lands in rough with 42% trees / water / OB.
Tee on an OSM box at 412 = card par 4. But the only other OSM golf=hole way is tagged par 5 / 467 yds, and this green is also used for hole 2. Numbering not confirmed against a course map.

course_review/1.summary: NOT safe to publish. 10 of 18 holes; holes 2 and 9 share one green; hole 3 plays across the clubhouse parking lot; 7 more tees are walk-backs / lidar pads 17-112 yds off any OSM box. The 18-hole hand trace (osm_supplement.geojson) was NOT written: no imagery or course map reached this sandbox in time (tourn_truth needs course_data/packages/jayhawk_club with committed NAIP; a package_jayhawk_club.json request to course_package.yml was pushed to create it). Guessing greens without imagery would plant wrong holes, so none were invented.
